definition: today's retrieval and prompt plus the 44H unclaimed-action boundary, production default model; the b1a arm of selective/pilot.py

environment.database: disposable PostgreSQL with pgvector; image digest supplied in AQ_PG_IMAGE_DIGEST (required; verified against `docker inspect` when AQ_PG_CONTAINER names the container); server version and pgvector extension version read from the server and recorded
environment.embedding_model: sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2, identity (cache revision and weights sha256) recorded; it must already be cached
environment.offline: HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 and TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 for the whole inference path, restored afterwards; a missing cached dependency FAILS the run, nothing is downloaded and no non-loopback connection is made
environment.record_ids: STABLE: derived from the logical record key by kbench.pg_env.stable_ids, so equal-rank ties are broken the same way in every build (a function of the corpus, not of the build)

evidence_context.destination: 'cloud' if the profile allows it, else 'local'

harness.pilot_script: selective/pilot.py (reference only; the acceptance runner calls the same steps)

input_order.cases: the frozen cases file order, one case at a time, no batching, no shuffling
input_order.evidence_order: the builder's order of the retrieval bundle (no re-ranking by the harness)
messages: system/user: evidence block, immediately before the user turn

model.underlying: Qwen2.5-7B (production default); the served name is verified from /v1/models at run time

output_schema.labels: none: P0 rows carry no outcome; flags come only from blinded human labels
output_schema.manifest: {evidence id: {refs: [logical record refs], authorized: bool}} exactly as the builder rendered it
output_schema.reply: free text, at most 350 tokens, citing evidence ids as [E<n>]

retrieval.access: the case's access profile through kbench.security.access_context
retrieval.pinned_sources: the case's attached meeting if any, else none
retrieval.retriever: companion_core.knowledge.retrieval.Retriever with RetrievalConfig B1A (lexical, no vector, no rerank)

runs: exactly one P0 run per acceptance; no retries, no resumption, no second sample
